questions.q: What is the best description of what Oracle Fusion Expenses does?
options: It automates capturing, policing, approving, accounting for, and reimbursing employee business spending
It only prints paper reimbursement checks
It replaces the General Ledger entirely
It is used exclusively to track fixed assets
questions.explain: Expenses manages the full cycle of employee spending from capture through reimbursement — it does not replace the GL or handle fixed assets.

questions.q: Put the expense lifecycle stages in order: Submit, Incur, Account, Audit and Approve, Capture, Reimburse.
options: Incur, Capture, Submit, Audit and Approve, Account, Reimburse
Submit, Incur, Capture, Reimburse, Account, Audit and Approve
Account, Incur, Submit, Capture, Audit and Approve, Reimburse
Reimburse, Incur, Capture, Submit, Account, Audit and Approve
questions.explain: The correct order is: incur, capture, submit, audit and approve, account, reimburse.

questions.q: Who actually issues the payment to an employee or a corporate card issuer for an approved expense report?
options: Oracle Fusion Expenses issues the payment directly
Oracle Fusion Payables, after Expenses hands off the approved report
The General Ledger issues the payment
Fixed Assets issues the payment
questions.explain: Expenses is a feeder system. It accounts for the spending and hands off to Payables, which performs the actual payment, just like a standard invoice.

questions.q: In this course's running example, what kind of company is Castellan Supply Co.?
options: A nonprofit food bank
A government tax authority
A mid-sized industrial distributor with about 1,400 employees
A two-person consulting firm
questions.explain: Castellan Supply Co. is the fictional mid-sized industrial distributor used as the running example throughout this course.

questions.q: Which group of people reviews expense reports that automatic audit rules flag for manual inspection?
options: Expense auditors
Fixed asset administrators
Corporate card issuers
External tax authorities
questions.explain: Expense auditors review reports that violate audit rules before the report can finish approval, separate from the employee's manager.
